prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return solution.go in package solution.
Required API: func DependenciesValid(nodes []string, edges [][2]string) bool
Behavior: Return true exactly when node names are unique, every directed edge endpoint is declared, and the directed dependency graph is acyclic. Empty input is valid.
Visible example: nodes [parse, build, ship] with parse->build and build->ship is valid; adding ship->parse makes it invalid.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code:
package solution
func DependenciesValid(nodes []string,edges [][2]string)bool{m:=map[string]int{};for _,n:=range nodes{if _,ok:=m[n];ok{return false};m[n]=0};g:=map[string][]string{};for _,e:=range edges{if _,ok:=m[e[0]];!ok{return false};if _,ok:=m[e[1]];!ok{return false};g[e[0]]=append(g[e[0]],e[1]);m[e[1]]++};q:=[]string{};for n,d:=range m{if d==0{q=append(q,n)}};seen:=0;for len(q)>0{x:=q[len(q)-1];q=q[:len(q)-1];seen++;for _,y:=range g[x]{m[y]--;if m[y]==0{q=append(q,y)}}};return seen==len(nodes)}
